headline: Will I ever stop missing him?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE BANNED, which makes this the hardest family to write kindly: 'it will pass', 'you'll feel better', 'time heals', 'give it a year' are all promises of an end, and 'you will always miss him', 'a part of you always will' are life sentences. The duration question simply cannot be answered, so none of these reads tries. 🔴 No tactic — no 'let him go', no deleting photos, no 'start dating'. 🔴 No pathologising and no clinical labels: obsessed, unhealthy, trauma bond, codependent, attachment issues, low self-worth are every one of them out. 🔴 And nothing that claims his interior.

Finding: she is asking for a DURATION, and there is no clock to read. What can be said instead is that missing is not a failure to progress — there is no schedule she is behind on, and someone has made her feel there is.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the lilies at his feet are white and fully open.
You asked if you'll ever stop missing him. Your hand went to the man with no calendar.
So yes, dear — this does get lighter. Nobody can tell you when.
And there's not one date anywhere on his card, dear.
But there was never a schedule for it, dear. Nobody set one.
That's why you feel behind, dear. You've been marking yourself late.
Let me look closer at what has been keeping this so present…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the beam above him doesn't bend at all.
You asked if you'll ever stop missing him. Your hand went to the card that holds without ending.
So this holds for now, dear, and holding is not the same as forever.
And nobody is timing him up there, dear. Nobody is timing you.
But missing is not a task with a date on it, dear.
That's why each month feels like a failing, dear. You set a due date.
Let me look closer at what set that deadline on you…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the road behind him isn't in the picture.
You asked if you'll ever stop missing him. Your hand went to the one who carries what he carries.
So you can carry this and still walk, dear. He does exactly that.
And the bundle moves with him, dear. He doesn't put it down to go.
But you were handed two choices only, dear. Carry it, or stop.
That's why it feels like failing. There's a third way, dear.
Let me look closer at what made this a matter of stopping…
